data.narrative:
Bountiful is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Megan Nunes, Tomas Svitek, and Michael Bertino, having raised $5.0M to date. The sector peer universe comprises 9 private companies and 1 public company (ticker 277810.KQ), including observed private peers such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Stage-progression analysis was the applicable valuation method. Using the $5.0M total raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $12M. This reflects observed market dynamics for robotics companies advancing from seed funding.

Peer-median benchmarking was not applicable due to insufficient comparable data. While 10 robotics and manufacturing peers exist in the broader sector, the filtered peer set (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier) contained fewer than three datapoints, making narrow-universe median analysis unreliable. A broad all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise.

The triangulated valuation range is $11M (low) to $14M (high), with a median of $12M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodology. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight peer comparables at the seed stage in this sector and the stage-progression multiplier's sensitivity to market conditions. Additional evidence from subsequent financing rounds or expanded peer availability would strengthen conviction in this range.
